explanations.en: Lexical source selector `dimensionError`: after any string directives, the body contains ordered if-return guards and one final return. First, the source tests `!target`; its truthy branch contains a return with written expression `"Enter a positive whole number for each dimension."`. Only if preceding tests complete falsy, the source tests `target.width * target.height > 32_000_000`; its truthy branch contains a return with written expression `"The output must not exceed 32 million pixels."`. Only if preceding tests complete falsy, the source tests `target.width * target.height * info.frameCount > 64_000_000`; its truthy branch contains a return with written expression `"This animation exceeds the output frame pixel limit."`. If all tests complete falsy, the final statement contains a return with written expression `null`. No guard has an else. This is written synchronous-body syntax only; parameter initialization, name bindings, helper/getter effects, runtime ownership and normal completion remain unverified.

Se todos os testes terminarem com valor lógico falso, a instrução final contém um retorno com a expressão escrita `null`. Nenhuma guarda tem else.
